original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚军方在卡杜纳和卡齐纳解救被绑架人员
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚西北联合特遣部队“Fansan Yamma”行动部队在卡杜纳州和卡齐纳州分别开展行动，解救六名被绑架人员。军方称行动依据情报线索并回应求救呼叫，于9月17日实施。相关行动还包括在卡杜纳-比尔宁瓜里公路查获一名涉嫌贩毒人员，以及在索科托州击退恐怖分子袭击并解救两名被绑架人员。

key_facts.fact: 尼日利亚军方在卡杜纳州和卡齐纳州解救六名被绑架人员
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Troops of the Joint Task Force North-West, Operation Fansan Yamma, have rescued six kidnapped victims during separate operations in Kaduna and Katsina states.

key_facts.fact: 军方称行动依据情报线索并回应求救呼叫，于9月17日实施
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The victims were rescued on Thursday, September 17, following intelligence-led operations and responses to distress calls in the two states.

key_facts.fact: 在卡杜纳-比尔宁瓜里公路查获一名涉嫌贩毒人员
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: troops of Sector 1, conducting a stop-and-search operation along the Kaduna-Birnin Gwari road, intercepted Yohana Musa in possession of a large quantity of illicit drugs and substances

key_facts.fact: 在索科托州击退恐怖分子袭击并解救两名被绑架人员
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: troops of Sector 2 responded to a distress call following a terrorist attack at Unguwan Lalle in Sabon Birni Local Government Area of Sokoto State... rescuing two kidnapped victims in the process
